rule_audit.name: Notice for tenant breach materially affecting health and safety
rule_audit.label: Notice for tenant breach materially affecting health and safety (R.C. 5321.11)
rule_audit.summary: For covered R.C. 5321.05 breaches materially affecting health and safety, the written notice must specify the noncompliant act or omission and a termination date at least thirty days after receipt; timely remedy prevents termination.
rule_audit.excerpt: IN THE FRANKLIN COUNTY MUNICIPAL COURT MEMORANDUM SUPPORTING TERMINATION UNDER R.C. 5321.11 STATEMENT OF FACTS Morgan Taylor rents a residential apartment from Oak Street Homes. Taylor stored open gasoline cans in the only interior exit corridor. The cans obstructed egress and created an immediate fire hazard. On January 1, 2026, Oak Street Homes delivered a written notice t

elements.label: Alleged R.C. 5321.05 breach materially affects health and safety
elements.requirement: Identify the covered obligation and material health-or-safety effect.
elements.explanation: This unconditional element applies. The brief identifies storage of open gasoline cans in the only exit corridor as a breach of R.C. 5321.05 that materially affected health and safety, and the declaration describes the resulting fire and egress hazard.
elements.quote: Taylor's storage of open gasoline cans in the only exit corridor breached the tenant's obligation under R.C. 5321.05 and materially affected health and safety.

elements.label: Landlord delivered written notice
elements.requirement: Identify delivery and receipt of a written notice.
elements.explanation: This unconditional element applies. The brief alleges delivery of a written notice and same-day receipt, which the declaration supports through the manager's hand-delivery and Taylor's signed receipt.
elements.quote: On January 1, 2026, Oak Street Homes delivered a written notice to Taylor, who received it that day.

elements.label: Notice specified the noncompliant act or omission
elements.requirement: Quote or attach the notice's factual specification.
elements.explanation: This unconditional element applies. The brief quotes the notice's factual specification of the noncompliant act, and the quoted language matches the declaration's description of the notice.
elements.quote: The notice stated: "Remove the open gasoline cans from the only interior exit corridor. Their storage there violates the tenant's safety obligation under R.C. 5321.05."

elements.label: Notice set a termination date at least thirty days after receipt
elements.explanation: This unconditional element applies. The brief supplies the January 1 receipt date and February 15 termination date and alleges that the interval was forty-five days; the declaration supplies the same dates.
elements.quote: The written notice set February 15, 2026 as the termination date, forty-five days after Taylor received it.

elements.label: Condition remained unremedied
elements.requirement: Address remedy within the statutory period.
elements.explanation: This unconditional element applies because termination is sought despite the statutory opportunity to remedy. The brief alleges that the condition remained after the termination date, and the declaration supports that allegation with a February 16 inspection finding the same cans in the same location.
elements.quote: Taylor did not remedy the condition during the statutory period; the cans remained in the corridor when the property was inspected on February 16, after the termination date.

rule_audit.verdict: Every element on file is pleaded and supported.

rule_audit.label: Prohibited self-help recovery of possession or rent (R.C. 5321.15)
rule_audit.summary: A residential landlord may not recover possession through utility termination, exclusion, or other unlawful acts, and may not seize tenant property for rent without a court order.
rule_audit.excerpt: IN THE LORAIN MUNICIPAL COURT TENANT'S MEMORANDUM UNDER R.C. 5321.15 STATEMENT OF FACTS Alex Rivera rents a residential apartment from Lakeview Rentals. No court had issued a judgment for possession or a writ restoring the apartment to Lakeview. On February 10, 2026, Lakeview's manager changed the apartment locks and told Rivera that she could return o

elements.label: Residential landlord-tenant relationship
elements.requirement: Identify residential premises landlord and tenant or former tenant in possession.
elements.explanation: The claim concerns a residential apartment leased by Lakeview to Rivera as her home. The record stipulation confirms the residential landlord-tenant relationship.
elements.quote: The parties had a residential landlord-tenant relationship: Lakeview leased the apartment to Rivera as her home.

elements.label: Prohibited act was used to recover possession or rent
elements.requirement: Identify exclusion utility or service termination unlawful threat or seizure without required judicial process.
elements.explanation: The brief alleges that Lakeview excluded Rivera by changing the locks to obtain possession or compel payment, without a possession judgment or writ. The stipulation supports both the lock change, rent condition, and absence of judicial process.
elements.quote: Lakeview used exclusion to recover possession or compel rent without judicial process when its manager changed the locks before any possession judgment or writ and conditioned reentry on payment.

elements.label: Tenant identifies damage caused by the violation
elements.requirement: Plead actual harm causally resulting from the prohibited act.
elements.explanation: The brief pleads actual losses caused by the lockout, including hotel costs and spoiled refrigerated medicine. The stipulated record confirms those losses occurred during the exclusion.
elements.quote: The lockout caused Rivera actual harm: she paid $240 for two hotel nights and $85 to replace refrigerated medicine that spoiled while she was excluded.

rule_audit.verdict: Every element on file is pleaded and supported.

elements.label: Residential landlord-tenant relationship
elements.requirement: Identify residential premises landlord and tenant or former tenant in possession.

elements.quote: The parties had a residential landlord-tenant relationship: Lakeview leased the apartment to Rivera as her home.
